comment: TWO LISTS THAT ARE IDENTICAL TODAY AND MEAN DIFFERENT THINGS. clientAddressableRelations is the set of relation names client code may name in .from(), enforced by scripts/lint_from_allowlist.sh. realtimePublicationMembers is the expected membership of the supabase_realtime publication, asserted against pg_publication_tables by tests/db/config_drift.test.ts. Each consumer reads ONLY its own key. Until 2026-09-21 both were served by one key named `mirrors`, and their contents coincide only because migration 013 published three tables and granted SELECT on the same three in one migration; migration 018 removes the mirrors from the publication and revokes SELECT, at which point the two lists stop agreeing. NOTHING ASSERTS THAT THEY AGREE, deliberately -- an assertion that they do is the coincidence this split exists to remove. `exposedSchemas` is the PostgREST-exposed schema list, read by tests/db/rls_anon_column_containment.test.ts and asserted against supabase/config.toml by tests/db/config_drift.test.ts. `rpcs` is read by the lint alongside clientAddressableRelations and constrains what may be NAMED, not how an RPC is invoked.
